minimum_evidence: Original approved file/source, source type, retrieval/upload time, SHA-256, approval basis
purpose: Provenance and later reconstruction of the reviewed source
handling_expectation: Use approved/public/authorized material only; avoid restricted information
prototype_location: case workspace / source artifact; checksum referenced in case state and audit
production_requirement: Authoritative records classification, access controls, legal hold, retention/disposition rule

minimum_evidence: Original and normalized values, missing fields, source reference, case ID
purpose: Trace the facts used by alignment and downstream analysis
handling_expectation: Human confirms fields against source; corrections must be traceable
prototype_location: case workspace and integrated case state
production_requirement: Authenticated editor identity and controlled amendment history

minimum_evidence: Profile ID/version, linked artifact versions/checksums, rules, reviewer roles, thresholds
production_requirement: Formal configuration owner, approval workflow, effective dating, rollback

minimum_evidence: Model ID/version/checksums, vocabulary/config, runtime environment, prediction metadata
handling_expectation: Integrity validation before use; domain warning retained
production_requirement: Model registry, validation approval, monitoring, drift/retraining governance

minimum_evidence: Passage identifier, section label, exact operator-supplied text
purpose: Show what text the bounded model actually evaluated
production_requirement: Document extraction/selection controls and completeness assurance

minimum_evidence: Request, retrieved items, citations, source versions, relevance/sufficiency scores, missing evidence, conflicts
purpose: Support or explicitly withhold authority for material claims
handling_expectation: Retrieval does not equal sufficiency; stale/missing evidence must remain visible
production_requirement: Governed authoritative corpus, update SLA, source ownership, legal applicability review

minimum_evidence: Recommendation code/strength, evidence, counterevidence, missing information, conditions, limitations, reviewer route
purpose: Preserve the original advisory output separately from the human decision
handling_expectation: Nonbinding language; recommendation remains immutable after human disposition
production_requirement: Authenticated generation, immutable version history, approved template governance

minimum_evidence: Reviewer identity, role, disposition, rationale, conditions/escalation target, timestamp
handling_expectation: Must remain distinct from system recommendation
prototype_location: human disposition output and case state
production_requirement: Enterprise identity proofing, authorization, delegation, separation-of-duties policy

minimum_evidence: Event IDs, actor type, timestamps, hashes/previous hashes, reason codes, stage status
handling_expectation: Fail closed if required audit persistence fails; sanitize sensitive data
production_requirement: Centralized immutable logging, monitoring, access controls, backup, incident procedures

minimum_evidence: Bundle manifest, file inventory, checksums, current state, audit continuity
purpose: Preserve a controlled case across ephemeral Colab runtime loss
production_requirement: Encrypted storage, authenticated access, lifecycle/retention controls

minimum_evidence: Frozen scenarios, metrics, failure analysis, refinements, candidate manifests, hosted quality-gate evidence
purpose: Demonstrate the validated technical baseline and later documentation overlays
handling_expectation: Historical manifests remain immutable; later documentation changes use overlays
production_requirement: Formal release/change records and independent validation evidence

minimum_evidence: Risk register, safeguard matrix, responsible owners, residual risks, production gates
purpose: Make governance assumptions and unresolved risks explicit
production_requirement: Governance body/owner, periodic review cadence, risk acceptance authority
